questions.question: The given statements are followed by two conclusions. Find out which conclusion is FALSE based on the given statements. Statements: S > K = L, M ≥ N < K, O < S < U, N = Q ≥ T Conclusions: I. U > L II. K ≥ T
questions.questionHtml:
The given statements are followed by two conclusions. Find out which conclusion is FALSE based on the given statements.

Statements:
S > K = L, M ≥ N < K, O < S < U, N = Q ≥ T

Conclusions:
I. U > L
II. K ≥ T

options.text: Both conclusion I and II are false
options.html: Both conclusion I and II are false

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II is false
options.html: Neither conclusion I nor II is false

questions.solution:
Evaluating Conclusion I: U > L

• From Statement 3, we know U > S.

• From Statement 1, we know S > K and K = L, which means S > L.

• Combining these (U > S > L), we can conclude that U > L.

• Therefore, Conclusion I is TRUE.

Evaluating Conclusion II: K ≥ T

• From Statement 1 and 2, we have L = K > N.

• From Statement 4, we have N = Q ≥ T.

• Chaining these inequalities together (K > N = Q ≥ T), the definitive relationship between K and T is K > T.

• Since K > T, the statement K ≥ T is not strictly guaranteed.

• Therefore, Conclusion II is FALSE.

Answer: Only conclusion II is false.

questions.question: Which of the following terms will replace the question mark (?) in the given series? WGP, AKT, EOX, ISB, MWF, ?
questions.questionHtml:
Which of the following terms will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

WGP, AKT, EOX, ISB, MWF, ?
questions.solution:
Logic:
Each letter in every position moves +4 steps forward in the alphabet.

Series:
WGP → AKT → EOX → ISB → MWF → ?

W + 4 = A, G + 4 = K, P + 4 = T
A + 4 = E, K + 4 = O, T + 4 = X
E + 4 = I, O + 4 = S, X + 4 = B
I + 4 = M, S + 4 = W, B + 4 = F

So,
M + 4 = Q
W + 4 = A
F + 4 = J

Answer: (b) QAJ

questions.question: Direction: Identify the assumption that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option. Statement: The government has decided to increase investment in renewable energy projects to ensure sustainable development. Assumptions: I. Renewable energy plays an important role in sustainable development. II. The current level of investment in renewable energy is not sufficient. III. The government has enough resources to invest more in renewable energy projects.
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: Identify the assumption that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option.

Statement:
The government has decided to increase investment in renewable energy projects to ensure sustainable development.

Assumptions:
I. Renewable energy plays an important role in sustainable development.
II. The current level of investment in renewable energy is not sufficient.
III. The government has enough resources to invest more in renewable energy projects.

options.text: Only I and II are implicit
Only II and III are implicit
All I, II, and III are implicit
options.html: All I, II, and III are implicit

questions.solution:
Logic:
Only assumptions directly needed for the statement are implicit.

Solution:
I. Renewable energy helps sustainable development → Implicit
II. Investment is being increased, so current investment is not enough → Implicit
III. Government has enough resources → Not implicit, because resources/funds are not clearly mentioned.

Answer: (a) Only I and II are implicit

Number of odd day between
15 Feb 2010 and 15 Feb 2011 = 1

Number of odd days between 15 Feb
2011 and 7 July 2011

13 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 7 = 30

Total odd days = 30 + 1 = 31 or (31 ÷ 7)
remainder = 3.

⇒ Monday + 3 = Thursday

questions.question: M started walking towards south. He turned 8 times right and 8 times left during his journey. In which direction he will be facing finally?
questions.questionHtml: M started walking towards south. He turned 8 times right and 8 times left during his journey. In which direction he will be facing finally?
questions.solution:
Logic:
Equal number of right and left turns cancel each other.

Initial direction = South
8 right turns and 8 left turns = same number of opposite turns
So, final direction remains the same as initial direction.

Answer: (c) South
